utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks—community shed at the usual time. I’ll head there and bring that spare screwdriver set if I remember it this time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s already moving along, then—I’d only heard second-hand they were getting organized. I might swing by the hall too and see what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, the shed’s the main meetup as far as I know—though checking the hall too couldn’t hurt. If I forget anything, I’ll just follow the crowd and hope Mara has the real plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, and bottled water in decent shape for the repair drive, but we’re still short on work lights. I’m asking around the block now and can text you the count once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—thanks, Cleo. I’m probably forgetting the latest plan again, but I’m still thinking the community shed this Saturday—just text me the time once you know, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, that’s still the plan as far as I’ve heard—community shed Saturday. I’ll text you the time once it’s confirmed, and the work light count too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, roof first then—if the area’s clear, I’ll bring the ladder and tarp and get started.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate it, Leo—once you’ve got that covered, swing by the drive after and I’ll put you to work with the simple fixes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I’ll do the shed roof first, then head over and help with the easy fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, I’m still set to help with the repair drive—community shed at the usual time, and I’ll bring the signup sheet and donation box.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara—that helps a lot. I’m checking with the organizers for the latest signup count and whether they still need more volunteers or any specific tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Sam — I’m still planning to come early Saturday to help set up, so just let me know if Rosa needs anything extra.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Jules, can you confirm the schedule first, and while you’re at it, do we know the tool list and the drop-off spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the schedule or tool list locked in from my side yet, but I can help chase that down and keep spreading the word once we’ve got the drop-off spot confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—can you confirm all three before I commit: the schedule, the tool list, and the drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Eli, I’m hearing the repair drive could still use basic hand tools, and Mara may be bringing extension cords. If you stop by, tell me what’s still missing and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess — if Mara’s got extension cords covered, we’re still missing a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool. Please let folks know to bring those if they can, and keep it to items they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Eli — I’ll spread the word that you still need a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, and I’ll remind folks to bring only what they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the exact time and place, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear so we can keep folks posted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira—that helps. As soon as you get the time and place, send it my way and I’ll pin it to the signup with the addresses so we know who’s closest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I’m out running errands anyway, so I’ll pass it along the minute I hear and keep mentioning the repair drive to folks.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The shed roof’s the main thing—it’s leaking badly. If Bo can help Saturday, I’d be grateful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do Saturday—just text me the time, and I’ll bring my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll send the time later today—your tools will help a lot with the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can come by mid-morning after school drop-off and help until I need to head back for pickup. I’ll double-check the repair list and confirm whether Malik’s definitely handling pickups too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds really helpful, thanks. If you hear what’s still missing after you check the list, let me know and I’ll bring my screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll check after drop-off and send you what’s still needed, and I’ll make sure about Malik handling pickups too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive, Rosa, and as soon as I get the exact time and place I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Vik—that helps a lot. We’re aiming for Saturday morning at the community garden lot, and I’ll send you the exact start time as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Rosa—I’ll keep telling people it’s Saturday morning at the community garden lot, and as soon as you confirm the start time I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Quinn, have you heard the latest signup count for the repair drive, and do they still need more volunteers or any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I haven’t heard the latest count yet, but we’re set on Saturday, 10 to noon at the community shed, and I’m checking today on the drop-off flow and a couple of truck helpers before I spread the word wider. If you know anyone handy, tell them we’ll likely want a few more volunteers and folks should plan to bring small appliances, lamps, and tools they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—that helps. When you hear back, can you get me the actual signup count and whether they need any specific tools so I can pin it down?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad we’re moving on it, but can we lock down the tool list and one drop-off spot first? I really don’t want people hauling things over before we know where it all goes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Pia—you’re right, let’s keep it simple: one drop-off spot and a quick tool list first, and I can help sort tools once we’ve got that set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, Dane—once we’ve got the tool list and the drop-off spot nailed down, I’ll feel much better about telling people to start bringing things over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve heard mostly about small fixes so far, and I’m thinking of bringing a screwdriver set. Do you know if they still need anything basic besides hand tools?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: A screwdriver set sounds useful, but I’d really like us to confirm the tool list and the drop-off spot first so people don’t bring duplicates or leave things all over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense. If you hear the confirmed list or drop-off spot first, let me know and I’ll bring whatever’s still actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s coming together pretty well, Kira—mostly table-fix kind of repairs so far, and I’m bringing my tools to help folks work through the simple stuff.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds fine, Gus, but are we actually confirmed for this weekend yet, and do we know the tool list and drop-off spot before people start hauling things over?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, we’re set for this weekend at the community room, and I’m putting the tool list by the drop-off table tonight so folks know what to bring and where to leave things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Jules, I’m hearing the repair drive still needs a few basic hand tools, and Mara may be bringing extension cords. If you stop by, tell me what’s still missing and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Definitely—I’ll check what tools are still missing when I stop by, then I’ll pass it along so more folks can help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a big help, Jules—sounds like the drive’s coming together, and once you hear what they still need, I’ll make sure the word gets around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I tell Kira anything, can we confirm whether the repair drive is definitely this weekend and who finalized the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the exact time and place, so I can’t confirm this weekend yet, but as soon as whoever’s finalizing it tells me, I’ll pass it along to you and everyone else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that’s exactly what I needed to know — please let me know once the schedule’s actually confirmed, and if you hear who finalized it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, have you heard the latest sign-up count for the repair drive, and do they still need more volunteers or any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest count yet, but they’re still gathering folks as far as I know. I’m still waiting on the exact details too, though Bo’s ready to bring basic tools once we hear more.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—can you check with the organizers today and ask for the current sign-up count plus whether they need more volunteers or any specific tools?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I think I can make it, but what time are we meeting by the community shed again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again, Noah—it’s by the community shed at ten, and I can jump in sorting tools as soon as we get there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, ten—got it, thanks. I’ll head to the community shed then and try not to lose track again.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive mid-morning after school drop-off, but can you remind me which repairs we’re covering and whether Malik’s definitely handling pickups?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re keeping it to small carry-in items like lamps, tools, and small appliances, Saturday from 10 to noon at the community shed, and I’m still lining up the pickup folks so I don’t want to promise Malik just yet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it, thanks — mid-morning still works for me after drop-off, and I’ll plan on carry-in repairs unless you confirm pickups before then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still set to help with the repair drive, and I’ll be there early Saturday for the tables and signage. Are you still bringing that spare screwdriver set to the community shed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can bring the screwdriver set over to the shed before we get started. Thanks for coming early, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks, Uli — I’ll have the signup sheet and donation box with me, so we should be in good shape once we get the tables set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, let’s stick with Saturday from 10 to noon at the community shed, and tell folks to bring small appliances, lamps, and hand tools they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good to me—I’ll pass that along and check with the organizers on the current signup count and whether they still need more volunteers or any specific tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect—that keeps it tidy; once you have the signup count and tool needs, let me know and we’ll make a short final list for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear—I’d only caught second-hand that they were getting organized. I might swing by the community hall and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good idea—shed roof’s first on the list, and I’m bringing a ladder and tarp. If you stop by, ask what small jobs still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps—I’d only heard bits and pieces, so I’ll ask at the hall what smaller jobs still need doing and see where I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—that’ll make things much easier. Once you add those details, I’ll group everything by block and make sure we’re ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—I’ll add the addresses and building numbers now, and I’ll flag Maple, Cedar, and the south end of Birch so the drop-off planning stays tidy for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal—thank you. Once that’s in, I’ll sort the sheet by block and double-check the Saturday layout so everything runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Bo, I’m pretty sure it’s still the community shed at the usual time—Mara confirmed it, thankfully. I’ll head there first and bring that screwdriver set if I remember it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just text me the time to be safe, and I’ll bring my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do—same usual time, unless I’m muddling it again, but Mara seemed sure. I’ll text you before I leave so neither of us ends up at the wrong place.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
